newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to open Credit Lyonnais aid probe - EU source.
newsitem.headline: EU set to open Credit Lyonnais aid probe - EU source.

text.p: The European Commission is expected on Wednesday to open a state aid probe into the purchase by troubled French bank Credit Lyonnais of Societe de Banque Occidentale (SDBO), a European Union source said on Friday.
EU set to open Credit Lyonnais aid probe-EU source

"We're raising a series of questions on this specific element of the (Credit Lyonnais) restructuring plan," the source said, referring to the 45-billion-franc French government rescue plan approved with conditions by the Commission last year.
"There might be elements of state aid, we believe, in the way it (the purchase) has happened," the source added.

SDBO was a Credit Lyonnais unit before being transferred to the Consortium de Realisation (CDR) asset-sale body, the government body created to sell the bank's assets as part of the rescue plan. But in February Credit Lyonnais said it had signed a pact to take back the assets and staff of SDBO from CDR.
